strataglyph.server.path.markdownDescription: The strataglyph CLI to run as the language server: a `.mjs` or `.js` file run with `node` (such as `skills/strataglyph/scripts/strataglyph.mjs` in a checkout) or an `strataglyph` executable. A value with a folder in it or starting with `.` is read from the first workspace folder; a bare name such as `strataglyph` is looked up on PATH. Empty runs `npx -y @atluri0001/strataglyph lsp`. Set in user settings only, so a repository cannot choose what runs. Reload the window after changing it.

strataglyph.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and strataglyph lsp in the strataglyph output channel.
